title: 基本操作｜二元樹：用 array 一層一層存
question:
二元樹（binary tree）的每個點最多有兩個孩子：左孩子和右孩子。如果從最上面開始，一層一層、由左到右把點放進 array，就不用另外記誰是誰的孩子：
位置 0 是最上面的根；位置 i 的左孩子在 2 * i + 1，右孩子在 2 * i + 2，上一層在 (i - 1) / 2（整數除法）。以後的 heap sort 就是這樣存樹的。
第一行輸入 n（不超過 20），接著一層一層輸入 n 個數字，再輸入 N，接下來輸入 N 個指令：
1 i：輸出位置 i 的左孩子；沒有就輸出 None!
2 i：輸出位置 i 的右孩子；沒有就輸出 None!
3 i：輸出位置 i 的上一層；i 是根就輸出 Root!
要輸出的是那個位置放的數字。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。

en.title: Basics | binary tree: store it level by level in an array
en.question:
In a binary tree, each point has at most two children: a left child and a right child. If we put the points into an array from the top, level by level, left to right, we do not need to write down who is whose child:
Place 0 is the root at the top. The left child of place i is at 2 * i + 1, the right child is at 2 * i + 2, and the point above is at (i - 1) / 2 (whole-number division). Heap sort keeps a tree this way, too.
First input n (20 or less), then the n numbers level by level, then N, then N commands:
1 i: output the left child of place i. If there is none, output None!
2 i: output the right child of place i. If there is none, output None!
3 i: output the point above place i. If i is the root, output Root!
Output the number in that place. Output each result on its own line.

test_case.note: 50 is at the top with 30 and 70 under it. 20 and 40 are under 30; 60 and 80 are under 70
The left child of place 2 would be place 5, but there are only places 0 to 4
